basic_details.job_title: CABS DRDO Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2027 – Apply Online for 18 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Airborne Systems (CABS), Bengaluru, a DRDO establishment under the Ministry of Defence, has invited Indian nationals to walk-in interviews for 18 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts in five engineering disciplines (Advt. No. CABS/JRF/2027/01). Eligible candidates are advised to email their willingness to [email protected] latest by 24 January 2027. Interviews are on 28 and 29 January 2027 at CABS, Belur, Yemlur PO, Bengaluru.

content_sections.heading: CABS Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Centre for Airborne Systems (CABS), Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence
Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in Aeronautical Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering and Mechanical Engineering
18 (the number of vacancies may change as per organizational requirement)
Rs. 37,000/- pm plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible
BE/B.Tech with valid GATE score, or ME/M.Tech, in the listed disciplines, in first division
CABS, DRDO, Belur, Yemlur PO, Bengaluru-560037
Willingness by email to [email protected] ; application form produced at the walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: About CABS
content_sections.text: The notice describes CABS, Bengaluru, as one of the premier research establishments of DRDO. It is involved in the indigenous Airborne Early Warning and Control Programme through the Airborne Surveillance Platform (ASP). CABS invites young and meritorious Indian nationals who wish to pursue defence related research as Junior Research Fellows.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Email address for willingness: [email protected] , latest by 24 January 2027. Subject line: "Application for the post of Junior Research Fellowship- Discipline". Application form: it can be downloaded from the website www.drdo.gov.in . The form is also printed in the notice. Interview venue and place of fellowship: Centre for Airborne System(CABS), DRDO, Ministry of Defence, Belur, Yemlur PO, Bengaluru-560037. Reporting: by 08:45 hrs on the interview date for your discipline. Applications are accepted from 0900 hrs to 1000 hrs. Candidates arriving late will not be allowed to participate. Queries: 080-25049393/9138/9135 on working days (Mon to Fri), 1400 hrs to 1600 hrs.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice prints no category-wise break-up of the vacancies. All five posts carry monthly emoluments of Rs. 37,000/- pm plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible. BE/B.Tech in the above disciplines in first division with valid GATE score. Only GATE scores of 2025 and GATE score of 2026 are acceptable. OR ME/M.Tech in the above disciplines in first division both at Graduate and Post-graduate level. Upper age limit: 28 years as on 31 Dec 2026. Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy Layer) candidates. A caste certificate copy is to be enclosed with the application, if applicable. Only Indian nationals can apply. Equivalent acceptable subjects: Aeronautical Engineering/ Aerospace Engg/ Aerospace Engg (Avionics). Equivalent acceptable subjects: Computer Science Engg/Technology, Computer Science & Engg/Technology, Computer Science Engg & IT, Software Engg/Technology, Computer Science & Automation Engg/Tech, Information Technology, Computer Science/Technology & Informatics Engg/Tech, Information Science & Engg/Technology, Computer & Communication Engg, Computer Networking. Equivalent acceptable subjects: Electronics & Communication Engg, Electronics Engg, Electronics & Computer Engg, Electronics & Control Engg, Electronics & Communication System Engg, Electronics & Instrumentation Engg, Electronics & Tele-communication Engg, Electronics & Telematics Engg, Industrial Electronics Engg, Tele-communication Engg, Telecommunication & Information Tech., Applied Electronics & Instrumentation Engg, Electronics & Electrical Communication Engg, Electrical & Communication Engg, Radio Physics and Electronics, Electrical Engg., Electrical & Electronics Engg, Electronics and Communication Engg (Avionics). Equivalent acceptable subjects: Electrical Engg, Electrical Power System Engg, Electrical & Electronics Engg, Electrical & Renewable Energy Engg, Power Engg, Power Electronics Engg, Electronics & Electrical Communications Engg, Electrical with Communication Engg. Equivalent acceptable subjects: Mechanical Engg, Mechanical & Automation Engg, Mechanical & Production Engg. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Tenure and Terms
content_sections.text: Tenure: initially two years, which may be extended for a further two years (one year at a time), subject to satisfactory performance assessed by a Review Committee. The offer of Fellowship does not confer on Fellows any right for absorption in DRDO. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining, irrespective of the selection.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application form is to be produced with self-attested copies of the following documents: Educational qualification certificates GATE score card Experience certificates Proof of date of birth Address proof Supporting document for CGPA to percentage conversion, if applicable Supporting document for category, if applicable Government issued Photo Identity Proof (Aadhar Card/PAN card/Passport etc, in original) A recent passport size photograph is to be affixed on the right top corner of the first page of the application. Documents in a language other than English need a duly self-attested English transcript.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The walk-in interview runs in three steps on the date for the candidate's discipline. 0900 to 1000 hrs: applications accepted. 1000 to 1100 hrs: initial screening and verification of testimonials. Incomplete applications are rejected during screening for eligibility. From 1100 hrs: interview of the screened shortlisted candidates. A panel for the available and future anticipated vacancies will be drawn based on the order of merit and will operate for one year. Empanelment alone does not entitle a candidate to an offer, which is contingent upon vacancies. The Director, CABS, reserves the right not to select any candidate if suitable candidates are not available. The decision of the committee constituted by the Director, CABS, is final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. How many JRF vacancies are there at CABS?
faq.answer: There are 18 JRF posts: Aeronautical 1, Computer Science & Engineering 6, ECE 6, Electrical 4 and Mechanical 1. The number may change as per organizational requirement.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to send willingness for the CABS JRF walk-in?
faq.answer: Willingness is to be emailed to [email protected] latest by 24 January 2027.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CABS JRF?
faq.answer: BE/B.Tech in the listed disciplines in first division with a valid GATE score (only GATE 2025 and 2026 scores are accepted), or ME/M.Tech in the listed disciplines in first division at both graduate and post-graduate level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CABS JRF?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 31 December 2026. SC/ST candidates get 5 years' relaxation and OBC (Non-creamy Layer) candidates 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for a DRDO CABS JRF?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 37,000/- pm plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice says the Rs. 37,000/- pm is plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. When is the CABS JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: ECE and Electrical candidates report on 28 January 2027. Aeronautical, Mechanical and Computer Science candidates report on 29 January 2027, by 08:45 hrs at CABS, Belur, Yemlur PO, Bengaluru-560037.

faq.question: Q8. What should be written in the email subject?
faq.answer: The subject must contain "Application for the post of Junior Research Fellowship- Discipline".

faq.question: Q9. How long is the JRF fellowship?
faq.answer: The offer is initially for two years, extendable for a further two years, one year at a time, subject to satisfactory performance assessed by a Review Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or joining, irrespective of the selection.
